Yes. If you’re willing to have existing testers grant Accessibility access again, I’d switch to `is.waiwai.openramble` before launch. macOS treats it as a new app identity. New users will go through the usual first-run permission flow.

If existing testers need a seamless upgrade, keep `is.waiwai.dictation`. If you choose to switch, update the release invariant, keep the existing Sparkle key, and verify the update from the current build before shipping.
